name: pr-review
description: Evidence-backed change review with specialized reviewers and independent challengers.

interface.shortDescription: Review changes with specialized, evidence-checked reviewers.
interface.longDescription: Reviews pull requests and local change sets across applicable code, comments, tests, errors, types, specifications, optional independent SPAR or Rubber Duck challenges, and security analysis, then double-confirms and consolidates the findings.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $pr-review to review the current pull request or change set.
